context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 128 tested the auto-classification enhancement for failed captures. The classifier uses rule-based pattern matching (no AI calls). Known junk patterns include: names in _JUNK_NAMES set, 'Nav-text name:' in failure_reason, UI keywords like 'profiles found', 'page', 'filter by'. After testing, 6 junk captures were auto-dismissed, leaving 1 genuine candidate (Rahul Sharma). The naukri_capture_logs collection now has 39 recovered captures with various recovery_method values: auto_classified_junk, duplicate_found, manual_save_to_bank, bulk_dismissed.
